name: Centro and the Lakefront
tagline: The town centre on Llanquihue, with Osorno across the water
description: Puerto Varas's compact centre along the lake shore, with the German-founded wooden houses, the Sacred Heart church modelled on one in the Black Forest, the restaurants and the casino, and the volcano Osorno framed across the water. Everything is walkable within a few blocks.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the lakefront, the restaurants and the volcano view on foot
pros: Lake promenade with the volcano view directly there
All restaurants, shops and services close by
Buses to Puerto Montt, Bariloche and the parks
cons: The highest rents in the town, higher again in January
Busy with Chilean holidaymakers in summer
Traffic through the centre in season

name: Philippi Hill and the Upper Town
tagline: The slope above the centre, wooden houses and the best views
description: The hillside behind the town where the original German settler houses stand, several of them national monuments, with steep streets and views over the lake to both Osorno and Calbuco. It is quieter than the lakefront and a five-minute walk down to it.
bestFor: Stays wanting the heritage houses and the widest view over the lake
pros: The best views over the lake and both volcanoes
Five minutes downhill to the centre

name: Puerto Chico
tagline: East along the shore, quieter and residential
description: The residential stretch running east along the lake from the centre, with houses and small apartment buildings facing the water, a beach and a calmer pace. It is ten to fifteen minutes on foot from the restaurants and considerably quieter, with the same view.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting the lake view without the centre's summer noise
pros: Same lake and volcano views, much quieter
cons: Fifteen minutes on foot to the restaurants
Exposed to the wind off the lake

name: Alerce and the Northern Residential Areas
tagline: Inland from the lake, where the year-round population lives
description: The residential districts spreading north and west away from the water, with ordinary Chilean housing, supermarkets, schools and a settled population that has nothing to do with tourism. Rents here are a fraction of anything lakeside and the centre is fifteen minutes away.
bestFor: Longer stays where the Chilean cost level needs working around
pros: The lowest rents in the area
A year-round community rather than a holiday town
cons: No lake view and little character
Fifteen to twenty minutes to the centre
Nothing to walk to in the evening

name: Ensenada and the Volcano Road (40 km east)
tagline: Out along the lake towards Osorno and the national park
description: The road running east along the lake shore to Ensenada, at the foot of Osorno volcano and the entrance to Vicente Perez Rosales national park, with the Petrohue falls beyond. Scattered cabins and lodges among native forest, with the ski centre on the volcano above.
bestFor: Stays built around the national park, the volcano and the forest
pros: National park, the falls and the volcano at the door
cons: Forty minutes to Puerto Varas and a car is essential
Very limited services and slow internet
The 2015 Calbuco eruption affected this area badly
